nodes.text:
No name. I gave it up, which is the only reason I'm still standing here.

I sell the taking half. Come close, if you're coming.

To the fire, in place of the rest of me. It took the name and it left the body, and it has never once come back to renegotiate.

So yes: I know exactly what a taking-word costs, because I paid the largest one there is and I got change. Don't buy them casually.
